title: "Metadata Grid"
author: "Norah Jones"
date: "2026-07-01"
date-modified: "2026-07-10"
doi: "10.1234/example.5678"
description: "A one-line description."
keywords:
  - music
  - texas
categories:
  - analysis
  - jazz
# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z). P3 (bd-j6huijli): the full
# metadata grid — Modified/Doi cells, keywords + description blocks,
# and category chips (title-block-categories defaults to true).
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "header#title-block-header.quarto-title-block.default",
            "div.quarto-title > h1.title",
            "div.quarto-title > div.quarto-categories > div.quarto-category",
            "div.description",
            "div.quarto-title-meta p.date",
            "div.quarto-title-meta p.date-modified",
            "div.quarto-title-meta p.doi > a[href='https://doi.org/10.1234/example.5678']",
            "div.keywords > div.block-title",
            "div.keywords > p",
          ]
---

Body.
